text_block_list.text:
The first three years of the Twinkle Series
have come to an end.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
There are no signs of any particular deterioration.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
If it's the upper-body-focused menu you showed me earlier,
I don't think there should be any problem.

Days continued of training alongside her,
aiming for her leg to fully heal.
—Then one day...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Today we have core training, the pool, and then a light jog along the forest trail, right!
All right, I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Oh, if it isn't Dants!

text_block_list.name: Pocket's Pals
text_block_list.text: Mornin', Dants-san!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: G-Good morning! Everyone's so lively.

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ouss, sparks are flyin'!

text_block_list.name: Lip-Pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Wait, shoot, we're short on machines. I'll just sit back and watch at first~.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my bad.
Let's just take turns.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I'm almost done, so go right ahead!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No way, you're kidding.
It's fine, don't worry about it, Dants!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
No, really, it's true!
Well then, see you later!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey!
...Sheesh!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Sorry for doing this on my own.
It's not like I can work out properly at the gym right now, so I figured it'd be fine.
choice_data_list: Okay, let's push the gym session to later then

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me~.
Thank you so much!

At the training gym,
I happened to run into Jungle Pocket's group, and—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Alright.
Well then, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh. Well, well, well, if it isn't Dants-kun!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Good to see you here.
Are you in the middle of training too? You must be exhausted!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...?
Umm, I'm not tired yet, you know?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I see! But whether it's before or after is a trivial matter. Here, take this.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A restorative, fully nutritious health tonic!
Drink it down in one gulp!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Y-You're gonna drink that!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
......
Isn't it kind of colorful?

Earlier today at the pool, Agnes Tachyon tangled with me.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...C-C-C-Cafe-chan!?
Didn't you hear a weird voice just now!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Is that the sound of the wind?
Though it's too low for that, almost like a groan—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...It's better if you just assume...
...that it was "your imagination"...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh!? What does that mean!? What do you mean!?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Let's go...
Dants-san, Trainer-san... Hurry."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: What's that supposed to mean~?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Haaah.
choice_data_list: That was quite a rough day, huh?
That was quite a rough day, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's true.
Everyone was just the same as always.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Still, it made me really happy.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I mean, look, everyone was training, weren't they?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "Cafe-chan, Tachyon-chan, and Pokke-chan too... It makes me realize you're all going to keep running on and on!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Despite appearances, everyone really loves racing, don't they?
choice_data_list: You might be at the top of that list
You might be at the top of that list.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu!
I need to get back in top shape soon too.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Because I still want to compete with everyone on the big stage many more times.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. ...Yes!

"Using future fierce battles as fuel—first,
if I could just open one new door."
